units: <cite ref="Yevamot 92a:10">Yeb. 92ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 6b:15">Snh. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>יקוב הד׳ את ההר</he> let the law cut through the mountain (justice under all circumstances).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 2b:6">Ib. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>אין דִּינֵיהֶם ד׳</he> their decision is not binding.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:2">Keth. IX, 2</cite> <he>אין מרחמין בד׳</he> compassion must have no influence on the decision of the law.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:1">Ib. IX, 1</cite> <he>ד׳ ודברים אין לי וכ׳</he> I have no claim whatever &c. Snh. l. c. <he>שנים שבאו לד׳</he> two persons who come before court. Ib. VI, 1, v. <cite ref="C01061"><he>גָּמַר</he></cite>.—
B. Mets. 30ᵇ, a. fr. ד׳ תורה strict law, opp. לפנים משורת הד׳ inside the line of the law, equity.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 33a:9">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>עינוי הד׳</he> vexations of the law, unnecessary delay of sentence, <he>עיוות הד׳</he> perversion of the law, partiality and sophistry; <he>קילקול הד׳</he> disregard of the law, wrong sentence through carelessness.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>יום הד׳</he> the day of judgment (in the world to come).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>הצדיק את הד׳</he> to declare God’s judgment right, to submit to God’s decree with resignation, <he>צידוק הד׳</he> resignation.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite>, a. fr. <he>נתן ד׳</he> to give an account, to be made responsible.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:9">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>נטלו דִינָם</he> suffered punishment <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:7">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>לתבוע דִּינוֹ של וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="D01003"><he>דקיון</he></cite>) to make responsible for &c., cmp. <cite ref="D00711"><he>דִּיקְיוֹן</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:7">Ib.</cite> s. 12 end, a. fr. <he>מידת הד׳</he> the attribute of justice, Divine Justice, opp. <he>מידת הרחמים</he> Divine Mercy; v. <cite ref="M00252"><he>מִדָּה</he></cite>.—<he>בֵּית דִּין</he> (abbr. <he>ב״ד</he>) court, v. <cite ref="B00753"><he>בַּיִת</he></cite>.—<he>גְּזַר ד׳</he> decree, v. <cite ref="C00575"><he>גָּזָר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 65b:8">Kidd. 65ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>בעל ד׳</he> litigant, opponent in court.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 32b:8">Snh. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ מרומה</he> proceedings in court which bear evidences of fraudulent claims or statements.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a:1">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>מוסר ד׳ על חבירו וכ׳</he> one who appeals to the Lord for judgment on his neighbor.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 4b:17">Snh. 4ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 38a:4">Zeb. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני הד׳</he> by analogy from equal expressions, v. <cite ref="C00581"><he>גְּזֵרָה</he></cite>.
Ib. והלא ד׳ הוא is not this an analogy?—Esp. conclusion from minor to major (קל וְחוֹמֶר).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:6">Y. Kidd. I, beg. 58ᵇ</cite>; Bab.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 4b:10">Kidd. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ד׳ הוא</he> it is a proper conclusion; <he>מה … אינו ד׳</he> if a Hebrew hand-maid … is acquired by means of money, <he>אינו ד׳ וכ׳</he> is it not so much the more proper that a wife &c.—
Snh. 54ᵃ, a. fr. אין עונשין מן הד׳ the tresspass of a law derived by conclusion ad majus is not punishable.—לבא מן הד׳ וכ׳, v. דַּי.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 2b:3">Snh. 2ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ובד׳ הוא ד־</he> and by right &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 2b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הוא הד׳ דאפי׳</he> the same applies also to &c.—Pl. <he>דִּינִים</he>, <he>דִּינִין</he>, constr. <he>דִּינֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:8">Ḥag. I, 8</cite> <he>הד׳</he> the interpretations of laws, v.
<cite ref="Chagigah 11a:7">ib. 11ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1">Snh. IV, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>דיני ממונות</he> civil cases, <he>ד׳ נפשות</he> capital cases.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 21b:13">R. Hash. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ שבלב שלא וכ׳</he> sentences from a mere inner conviction, without witnesses &c.; a. fr.
